newsitem.title: south africa: RUGBY-BOLAND BEAT E.P. BY POINT IN CURRIE THRILLER.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY-BOLAND BEAT E.P. BY POINT IN CURRIE THRILLER.

text.p: Currie Cup minnows Boland beat test union Eastern Province 18-17 (halftime 15-7) in a thrilling encounter at the Boland Stadium in Wellington on Saturday.

First half tries from fullback Stefan Terblanche and centre Elmo Wolfaardt were answered by the visitors' scrum half Chad Alcock but a 15-7 interval lead against a strong wind seemed to have given the Bolanders control of the match.
But a penalty try eight minutes before the end for a dangerous tackle by Terblanche on opposite number Andries Fourie gave E.P. an unlikely 17-15 lead until just three minutes from the end.

Consistent pressure from the wine farmers' forwards eventually resulted in a penalty attempt for Francois Horn and the Boland right wing withstood the pressure to land the kick and win the game to the delight of the small but vocal crowd of 600.
Boland: Tries - Stefan Terblanche, Elmo Wolfaardt. Conversion - Francois Horn. Penalties - Francois Horn (2)
Eastern Province: Try - Chad Alcock, penalty try. Conversion - Andries Fourie (2). Penalty - Fourie.
